title: Savings Account Minimum Balance
content: Maintain the stated minimum average balance (MAB) each month to avoid service fees. SMS alerts are sent when balance drops near the threshold.

title: Debit Card Blocking
content: Lost or stolen debit cards can be blocked instantly via mobile banking, IVR, or by contacting support with identity verification.

title: UPI Transaction Limits
content: Unified Payments Interface supports up to ?1 lakh per day for most banks with a maximum of 10 transfers in 24 hours.

title: EMI Calculation Guidance
content: EMI equals principal times monthly rate times (1+r)^n divided by ((1+r)^n - 1). Use the EMI calculator tool for precise values.

title: NEFT Transfer Timings
content: NEFT transfers run 24x7 in half-hourly batches. Credit time may be up to 30 minutes depending on destination bank.

title: KYC Update Process
content: Submit officially valid documents and a recent photo via branch, online upload, or video KYC to refresh your profile details.

title: Fixed Deposit Interest Payout
content: Fixed deposits offer monthly, quarterly, or payout-on-maturity interest options. Senior citizens receive an additional 0.5% p.a.

title: Credit Card Billing Cycle
content: Billing cycles typically run for 30 days with a 15-20 day grace period. Pay before the due date to avoid finance charges.

title: Account Statement Request
content: Download statements from internet banking or request email delivery. Printed statements can be mailed on demand.

title: Two Factor Authentication
content: Online banking requires OTP-based second factor. Never share OTPs with anyone, including bank staff.
